phase: freeze before new executable in both models or original-world evaluation
rule: No manually authored stage objective passed to any action chooser. Same raw 7x7x3 image, direction, source mission and original seven actions. No private world state or scripted DoorKey route.
mechanism: Both candidates learn only source-selected before/action/after generic held-object retention, loss, acquisition, and visible scene changes. Local abstract feature: visible front kind and whether held slot at public image[3][6] contains original object type 5/6/7. Bounded empirical per-action support and deterministic public-hash tie.
score: When held: +6 observed retained-and-changed fraction, -8 observed held-loss fraction, +2 observed scene-change fraction. When unheld: +6 observed held-gain fraction, +2 scene-change fraction. Source counts are actual selected outcomes. Unknown contexts explore least-observed action. No chosen action is hardcoded.
source_acceptance: Linux Windows original source unit tests
Native chooser legal with no evidence and no external manual objective
Selected held-retain-and-change preferred to observed object-loss
Unchanged DK10 and R14 parent sources
